limits: Original character: identity fidelity compares the approved local OC portrait and scenes, not external Metal Gear canon.
Two camera views generated independently: left-eye monocular remains on anatomical left, far-side lens partially obscured in left-facing poses; mirroring forbidden.
All source PNGs remain byte-identical. Sheet cells are imperfectly aligned; import must use inspected alpha-component rectangles and pivots, never crop boots/hands/low sweep to the advertised grid.
Twelve independent poses per PNG, 72 across both facings. Timing and interpolation are game adaptations; walk contact/passing is readable but not a certified motion-capture cycle.
Minor interframe variation in armor folds, hair and equipment remains. Closest accepted design, not certified pixel-perfect 1:1.
Slot-specific motion groups share some poses: light/heavy punch and local control/optic are adapted keyframes; no canonical gameplay claim.
Render scale and actual collision geometry must stay independent; authored reach/guard/trap counterplay remains engine data.
Some wide frame rectangles include a neighboring pose; their native-PNG Canvas clip contour excludes that neighboring body. Original PNG pixels/files remain untouched.
Attack keyframes are mapped to actual engine startup/active/recovery phases; low uses a crouch startup frame then extended sweep and recovery.
The animation map follows the actual Parallaxe runtime moves: trap/recall/barrage deploy, carbine shoot, retreat walk, observe optic. Retreat reuses walking as an explicit adaptation.
1:1 original-universe fidelity is the target. This is a manually reviewed closest pixel-art recreation, not a certified pixel-exact extraction.
Motion keyframes and all timing are original CQC game adaptations; no claim these are exported original-game animations.
Independently generated left/right camera views preserve anatomical sides; screen mirroring is forbidden. Minor pose, costume microdetail and hair differences remain.
PNG source bytes are unchanged. Actual separated full-body crop bounds, pelvis/feet pivots and Canvas contours isolate each pose when a rectangular crop would show its neighbor.
Three sheets per view provide 36 poses per direction; aliases reuse frames and do not create more original poses. Retreat can reuse walk as an explicit adaptation.
Specific pistol and knife silhouettes are simplified at combat resolution; fine receiver markings, seams and camouflage micro-patterns are not certified identical.
Source chosen is the original PS2 pre-injury render; no eyepatch, red arm, horn or remake costume is added.
1:1 original-universe fidelity is the target. This is a manually reviewed closest pixel-art recreation, not a certified pixel-exact extraction.
Motion keyframes and all timing are original CQC game adaptations; no claim these are exported original-game animations.
Independently generated left/right camera views preserve anatomical sides; screen mirroring is forbidden. Minor pose, costume microdetail and hair differences remain.
PNG source bytes are unchanged. Actual separated full-body crop bounds, pelvis/feet pivots and Canvas contours isolate each pose when a rectangular crop would show its neighbor.
Three sheets per view provide 36 poses per direction; aliases reuse frames and do not create more original poses. Retreat can reuse walk as an explicit adaptation.
Official artwork salmon hair and GBC portrait pale/blond palette differ; this edition uses the official color artwork palette.
No green monocular, firearm, rifle reload, laser or prosthetic cable cannon is accepted. Tripwire/mine objects are rendered by the actual combat engine, not invented into body art.
Original-universe1:1 fidelity is the target; this manually reviewed2D raster recreation is accepted closest, not a certified pixel-exact extraction.
Closed ivory originalPS2 CQC suit only; sole dark kneepad and hip pouch stay on anatomicalRIGHT. Independent left/right source images, no mirroring or CaptainSurvive costume.
Motion/timing and hitbox behavior are authored2D CQC adaptations, not an exported originalPS2 animation. Shared punch frames and CQC throw poses do not certify unique original animations.
Opposite-foot walk contacts and complete boots were corrected through additional image-generation attempts; all attempts and original source bytes are preserved.
CQC blade poses show one knife in anatomicalRIGHT hand with a short empty chest sheath; the tiny sheath mounting and weapon receiver details remain simplified at combat resolution.
Patriot originalPS2 stockless shortM16 with integral carry handle and drum magazine follows the original inventory icon/capture; fine gun markings are not certified.

Native full-body rectangles and occasional Canvas contours isolate neighboring atlas figures; no source pixel cleanup/recolor/crop/rescale is saved. Low-alpha colored RGB fringes use the unmodified PNG alpha.
1:1 original-universe fidelity is the target; these are reviewed reference-grounded 2D keyframes, not certified pixel-identical PS2 model/texture/animation extraction.
The exact source identity/palette is original human Raiden from Konami MGS2 PS2 art and screenshots. No MGS4/MGR cyborg, visor, bandana or future incarnation is added.
HF blade shape/use is proved by real MGS2 game capture with explicit HF.BLADE HUD. The cited LP was played on PC; it is a supplemental weapon reference, not PS2 texture/palette proof.
SOCOM/chaff HUD glyphs establish silhouette, not material red color. Weapons use restrained dark metal; markings, seams and very small hardware details are simplified.
Six PNG provide36 authored poses per direction=72 original poses; aliases/recovery reuse do not inflate this count. Left/right were generated independently; mirror is disabled.
Original PNG bytes/dimensions preserved. Some bodies/weapon tips cross equal-cell boundaries; use observed complete alpha-connected body bounds and metadata contours when required.

Native body scale must remain constant across crouch, roll, KO and upright poses; feet/pelvis pivots preserve ground contact. LowProfile hitbox remains authored rectangular gameplay geometry, not a pixel-perfect sprite mask.

The right-view chaff release includes a detached tiny grenade fragment; isolate human body and keep actual engine projectile independent to avoid duplication. Left-view chaff preparation partly occludes small canister behind raised hand/head.
Minor hair/costume-seam/pose variation and alpha-edge antialiasing remain.

Observed upright native scales differ between independently generated source sheets (especially A-left); sourceFrameHeights equalizes stature while every pose within a PNG retains the same scale, including low rolls/KO.
Original-universe1:1 fidelity is the target; this manually reviewed2D recreation is accepted closest, not a pixel-exact originalPS1 model/texture/animation extraction.
Original MGS1 ShadowMoses SolidSnake only, medium steel-blue gray cloth and dark gear, young clean jaw, navy bandana; no NakedSnake camouflage/beard, MGS2/TwinSnakes/other costume.

Dim game lighting is supplemented by original Konami final fullbody art; later PS1 leg capture665s corrected mistaken ivory knee highlight interpretation through six targeted image_gen edits. Both knee fronts are now gray material; no source pixel recoloring was saved outside image_gen.

Original SOCOM Mark23 shape with long suppressor and underside module is based on final artwork and native inventory shape; details/markings remain simplified. Grenade follows originalMGS1 inventory; red HUD is not red material.

Unarmed jab/heavy/elbow/CQC-style grasp, grenade deployment, SOCOM firing and reload are adapted motion keys, not originalPS1 animation exports. Retreat uses reviewed walk keys with backward travel; no native original retreat cycle is claimed.
Independent left/right source art with original RIGHT firearm hand and thigh holster, LEFT support hand. Minor pose/equipment occlusion and seam variation remain; mirror is disabled.

Six PNG give72 unique poses; shared jab/heavy/elbow and super-shot aliases do not add extra authored frames. Crops follow12 actual disjoint alpha bodies per sheet, sometimes with native Canvas contours excluding a neighboring pose. Complete opaque head/hand/boot silhouettes remain inside PNG; wide full low/KO crops can approach edges by2–3pixels.

Per-source observed upright scale stays fixed for crouch/low/KO; no frame is stretched independently to a full-height figure. Source PNGs retain original dimensions and SHA bytes; all13generation attempts/prompts/references are preserved.

Observed upright native scales differ between independently generated source sheets (especially A-left); sourceFrameHeights equalizes stature while every pose within a PNG retains the same scale, including low rolls/KO.
Original-universe1:1 fidelity is the target; this manually reviewed2D recreation is accepted closest, not a pixel-exact originalPS1 model/texture/animation extraction.
Original MGS1 ShadowMoses SolidSnake only, medium steel-blue gray cloth and dark gear, young clean jaw, navy bandana; no NakedSnake camouflage/beard, MGS2/TwinSnakes/other costume.

Dim game lighting is supplemented by original Konami final fullbody art; later PS1 leg capture665s corrected mistaken ivory knee highlight interpretation through six targeted image_gen edits. Both knee fronts are now gray material; no source pixel recoloring was saved outside image_gen.

Original SOCOM Mark23 shape with long suppressor and underside module is based on final artwork and native inventory shape; details/markings remain simplified. Grenade follows originalMGS1 inventory; red HUD is not red material.

Unarmed jab/heavy/elbow/CQC-style grasp, grenade deployment, SOCOM firing and reload are adapted motion keys, not originalPS1 animation exports. Retreat uses reviewed walk keys with backward travel; no native original retreat cycle is claimed.
Independent left/right source art with original RIGHT firearm hand and thigh holster, LEFT support hand. Minor pose/equipment occlusion and seam variation remain; mirror is disabled.

Six PNG give72 unique poses; shared jab/heavy/elbow and super-shot aliases do not add extra authored frames. Crops follow12 actual disjoint alpha bodies per sheet, sometimes with native Canvas contours excluding a neighboring pose. Complete opaque head/hand/boot silhouettes remain inside PNG; wide full low/KO crops can approach edges by2–3pixels.

Per-source observed upright scale stays fixed for crouch/low/KO; no frame is stretched independently to a full-height figure. Source PNGs retain original dimensions and SHA bytes; all13generation attempts/prompts/references are preserved.
